_comment: Files and directories that must never enter the packaged desktop application.
Read by electron-builder.config.cjs when it copies the staged backend into resources/backend/.
Semantics: dir_names and file_names match a path component exactly; file_patterns
are minimatch patterns matched against the file name only, at any depth.
1.0.2 adds *.bak_*, *.before_* (dated backups such as mcool_bed.py.bak_20260803 and
sql.py.before_d04 were shipped in the v1.0.1 backend) and requirements.lock.txt (it pins
the development interpreter, not the bundled runtime, and named a host path).
